newsitem.title: YEMEN: Yemeni forces surround area where Germans held.
newsitem.headline: Yemeni forces surround area where Germans held.

text.p: Yemen security forces trying to free four kidnapped German tourists have surrounded the area where they are being held, an Interior Ministry official said late on Friday.
"Security forces are currently surrounding the area and are exerting efforts to free the German tourists and ensure their safety," the official SABA news agency quoted the official as saying.
The German foreign ministry on Friday said the four -- two men and two women -- had been abducted on Thursday.
The Yemeni Interior Ministry official said they were kidnapped by "destructive elements" while returning from the eastern Marib governorate to the Yemeni capital Sanaa.
He stressed that the abductors were bent on tarnishing Yemen's image and said the authorities ... "would not take it easy with these types of destructive element...".

Earlier this month, a group of seven German tourists on a motorcycle tour in Yemen were also kidnapped. They were held hostage by Yemeni tribesmen and released unharmed after more than a week in captivity.
The German foreign ministry said crisis centres had been set up in Bonn and at the German embassy in Sanaa to deal with the latest kidnapping.
In recent years, Yemeni tribes with grievances against the government or foreign oil firms have kidnapped scores of tourists, diplomats or other foreigners to use as bargaining chips.
The hostages were all released unharmed.
